item.title: Meta pledges to overhaul kids’ safety protections, pay $17 billion to settle social media case
item.description: A multibillion-dollar settlement with attorneys general from nearly every U.S. state and territory will mean new privacy and safety protections in Meta products.

item.title: US takes down alleged Chinese hacking tools used against Federal Reserve, DOJ and Senate
item.description: The DOJ said it disrupted Chinese state-backed tools used to scan, infect and exploit IoT devices for attacks on federal agencies and multiple industries.

item.title: Iran-linked hackers expand infrastructure across Europe and Middle East, report says
item.description: Researchers said they identified servers and domains associated with several countries in Europe and the Middle East, potentially pointing to a broader targeting profile for an Iranian hacking group.

item.title: 58 arrested in international cybercrime crackdown
item.description: Interpol officials said it uncovered a crime-as-a-service network in Argentina run by 196 people that provided website domains and money laundering support to West African organized crime groups like Black Axe.

item.title: Employee benefits platform Paylogix says hackers stole financial and health data
item.description: The benefits management firm Paylogix told regulators that hackers stole sensitive information on tens of thousands of people from its systems.
